name: Marionette Zero
source:
Several thousand years ago, a secret plan called "Heaven's Stone" was carried out. A "Heaven's Stone" was an artificial stone created by extracting a special power out of a certain stone. As a result, an unexpectable phenomenon happened and some reinforced their bodies and some felt no pain. Therefore, only a few people were allowed to carry the stone. However, a dreadful plan was being proceeded underwater....
